content.text: {"id": "mm6529a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Nationwide, 1,865 (31%) of the 6,104 drivers aged 16 or 17 years involved in fatal crashes"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "27% of drivers aged 16 years and 33% of drivers aged 17 years"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among drivers involved in night crashes, 1,054 (57%) crashed before 12:00 a.m."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Across the 40 included states, the proportion of drivers aged 16 or 17 years involved in fatal crashes"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "varied from 19% in Kentucky to 44% in New Hampshire (median = 31%)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "27% of drivers aged 16 years and 33% of drivers aged 17 years"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This descriptive report summarizes the characteristics of NDRs"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Analyses were restricted to drivers of passenger vehicles (i.e., automobiles, sport utility vehicles, pickup trucks, and vans) aged 16 or 17 years."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "State-level results were included for the states with ≥20 drivers in fatal crashes (N = 40)"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Numbers and proportions suppressed because night crashes <20."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
